purpose: Primary $^{12}$C+p inventory case: one initially available proton per carbon nucleus.

physical_form.description: Solid graphite/carbon dispersed in liquid H2 at 20 K; no-void additive-specific-volume reference mixture.

intended_accounting: One first proton capture is inventory-supported per carbon nucleus. Actual C12, N13, and O14 output is calculated from the network; this is not a promise of pure N13 production.
pusher: common concentric D-T pusher; specified separately
